notes.title: reduced difficulty from stage 11
notes.content:
* There is a programming error with cobwebs. By pressing the button not only did you not destroy the web, but on the contrary, you rebuilt it. That is, the more you pressed the button to escape, the longer the web lasted. LOL. We have corrected this.
* We are going to make the game less complicated at the end so that people can get the fifth achievement. Specifically, from stage 10 onwards, the enemies of the first and second stages stopped appearing, and only the most difficult ones appeared. Now they will appear and also the difficult ones, but these will take up space and will make the stages from 10 and up not so hard. They will be hard, but not that hard.
